Sigma comes from app-author input (ImageFilter::blur / GaussianBlur) and is only finite-checked, not bounded. Huge sigma saturates `as i32` to i32::MAX, so the collect tries to allocate about 4e9 f32s, and `i * i` overflows i32 for |i| > 46340 (panic in debug). Compute the square in i64 or f32 (`let x = i as f32; (-(x * x) / denominator).exp()`) and cap the radius to a documented maximum kernel size, e.g. `let radius = (3. * sigma).ceil().clamp(1., MAX_KERNEL_RADIUS as f32) as i32;`, then re-normalize so the kernel still sums to 1.
